segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func pointerInteraction(_ interaction: UIPointerInteraction, styleFor region: UIPointerRegion) -> UIPointerStyle? { var pointerStyle: UIPointerStyle? = nil if let interactionView = interaction.view { let targetedPreview = UITargetedPreview(view: interactionView) pointerStyle = UIPointerStyle(effect: UIPointerEffect.lift(targetedPreview)) } return pointerStyle } ```
